observations.deficiency: Buildings used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drug products are not free of infestation by rodents, birds insects, and other vermin.
observations.detail: Specifically, Your firm failed to maintain buildings free of insect infestation. From November 2025 through April 2026, your firm documented multiple pest control incidents in manufacturing and packaging areas of Building” including the presence of live insects in active manufacturing and inspection rooms where drug product was present or in-process, creating conditions under which drug products being manufactured, packaged, or held in these areas could have been exposed to insect infestation. e On March 13, 2026, a live insect (ant) was observed on the inspection table in Inspection Room [redacted] during the active inspection of [redacted] Tablets, Lot [redacted]. The portion of product present on the inspection table at the time of the incident was exposed to the insect and was discarded as waste (3.2 kg). Additional drums of the same lot (Drums [redacted]) were present in the room at the time of the incident. This event was documented under PR ID 4084969. e On March 17, 2026, live insects (Asian Subterranean Termites) were identified in Granulation Washroom [redacted] (Manufacturing [redacted] Floor) and Packaging Line ", Room [redacted], during active manufacturing and packaging operations. At the time of the incident, multiple drug product lots were in-process across granulation, encapsulation, compression, coating, and packaging areas, including but not limited to: e Granulation Area: Lots [redacted] e Chemical Weighing Area: Lots [redacted] e Encapsulation Area: Lots [redacted] e Compression Area: Lots [redacted] e Packaging Lines: Lots [redacted] As a result of this incident, the packaged portion of Lot [redacted] ( [redacted] Tablets, [redacted]) present on Packaging Line at the time of the incident was discarded as waste due to potential pest exposure. All manufacturing and packaging operations were halted for evaluation. This event was documented under PR ID 4082953. e From March 31 through April 17, 2026, nine additional pest control events involving live Asian Subterranean Termites were identified across multiple areas of Buildings [redacted], including Mechanical Rooms [redacted] and [redacted], [redacted] Warehouse Room [redacted], Material [redacted], Packaging Lines [redacted] (Rooms [redacted]), Granulation Room [redacted], and primary Gowning Area Room [redacted] Manufacturing and packaging operations were halted on multiple occasions for evaluation. These events were documented under PR ID 4099810.
observations.deficiency_ko: 의약품의 제조, 가공, 포장 또는 보관에 쓰는 건물에 설치류, 조류, 곤충, 그 밖의 해충의 침입이 없지 않다.
observations.detail_ko: 구체적으로, 회사는 건물에 곤충 침입이 없도록 유지하지 못했다. 2025-11부터 2026-04까지 회사는 건물의 제조·포장 구역에서 의약품이 있거나 공정 중인 가동 중인 제조실과 검사실에 살아 있는 곤충이 있었던 방제 사건을 여러 건 문서화했다. 이로 인해 이 구역에서 제조·포장·보관 중인 의약품이 곤충 침입에 노출될 수 있는 조건이 만들어졌다. 2026-03-13 [가림] 정제 로트 [가림]의 검사가 진행되던 중 검사실 [가림]의 검사대에서 살아 있는 곤충(개미)이 관찰됐다. 사건 당시 검사대에 있던 제품 부분은 곤충에 노출됐고 폐기물(3.2 kg)로 폐기됐다. 같은 로트의 추가 드럼([가림])이 사건 당시 검사실에 있었다. 이 사건은 PR ID 4084969로 문서화됐다. 2026-03-17 가동 중인 제조·포장 작업 중 과립화 세척실 [가림](제조 [가림]층)과 포장 라인, [가림]호실에서 살아 있는 곤충(아시아 지하 흰개미)이 확인됐다. 사건 당시 과립화, 캡슐 충전, 압축, 코팅, 포장 구역에 여러 의약품 로트가 공정 중이었고 여기에는 다음이 포함되나 이에 한정되지 않는다. 과립화 구역: 로트 [가림]. 화학 칭량 구역: 로트 [가림]. 캡슐 충전 구역: 로트 [가림]. 압축 구역: 로트 [가림]. 포장 라인: 로트 [가림]. 이 사건으로 사건 당시 포장 라인에 있던 로트 [가림]([가림] 정제)의 포장된 부분은 잠재적 해충 노출 때문에 폐기물로 폐기됐다. 모든 제조·포장 작업이 평가를 위해 중단됐다. 이 사건은 PR ID 4082953으로 문서화됐다. 2026-03-31부터 2026-04-17까지 살아 있는 아시아 지하 흰개미가 관련된 추가 방제 사건 9건이 건물 [가림]의 기계실 [가림]과 [가림], 창고실 [가림], 자재 [가림], 포장 라인 [가림](호실 [가림]), 과립화실 [가림], 1차 가운 착용 구역 [가림]을 포함한 여러 구역에서 확인됐다. 제조·포장 작업은 평가를 위해 여러 차례 중단됐다. 이 사건들은 PR ID 4099810으로 문서화됐다.

observations.deficiency: Written production and process control procedures are not followed in the execution of production and process control functions.
observations.detail: Specifically, A review of site-provided tracking data revealed a systemic pattern of Incident Investigations, Customer Complaint Investigations, and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) being allowed to exceed established due dates without timely extension requests, in violation of your firm's own written procedures. e Incident Investigations: A review of 240 investigation records opened between April 2024 and March 2026 showed that of the 219 records requiring extensions, only 37% had extension requests submitted on time. Your firm's SOP-002757594, Incident Investigation (Version 7.0, effective December 24, 2025), requires that extension requests be submitted and approved by Quality Assurance prior to exceeding the established due date. e Customer Complaint Investigations: A review of 141 complaint records opened between May 2024 and April 2026 showed that of the 104 records requiring extensions, only 33% had extension requests submitted on time. Your firm's SOP-002773463, Product Customer Complaints (Version 4.0, effective February 19, 2025), Section 6.5.7, explicitly requires that extensions be documented and approved prior to passing the date due. e Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs): A review of 169 CAPA records opened between May 2024 and May 2026 showed that only 36 records (21.30%) were completed or extended on time. The remaining 133 records (78.70%) exceeded their established due dates without a timely extension request. Your firm's SOP-002512192, Action Tracking System — Corrective Actions and Preventive Actions (Version 13.0, effective June 9, 2025), Section 6.1.6, requires that a due date extension be requested if a CAPA will not be closed by the due date. Your firm indicated that records are sometimes intentionally allowed to exceed their due dates in order to submit a single, more informed extension request. This practice is not consistent with your firm's established written procedures and does not constitute a recognized exception under any of the cited SOPs. Finished Dosage Form Drug Manufacturer Christian F Gomez Lugo Investigator
observations.deficiency_ko: 서면 생산 및 공정 관리 절차가 생산 및 공정 관리 기능의 수행에서 이행되지 않는다.
observations.detail_ko: 구체적으로, 사업장이 제공한 추적 데이터를 검토한 결과, 사건 조사, 고객 불만 조사, 시정 및 예방조치(CAPA)가 회사 자체 서면 절차를 위반해 적시의 연장 요청 없이 정해진 기한을 넘기도록 허용되는 체계적 양상이 드러났다. 사건 조사: 2024-04부터 2026-03 사이에 개시된 조사 기록 240건을 검토한 결과, 연장이 필요했던 219건 중 기한 안에 연장 요청이 제출된 것은 37%뿐이었다. 회사의 SOP-002757594 '사건 조사'(버전 7.0, 시행일 2025-12-24)는 정해진 기한을 넘기기 전에 연장 요청을 제출하고 품질보증이 승인하도록 요구한다. 고객 불만 조사: 2024-05부터 2026-04 사이에 개시된 불만 기록 141건을 검토한 결과, 연장이 필요했던 104건 중 기한 안에 연장 요청이 제출된 것은 33%뿐이었다. 회사의 SOP-002773463 '제품 고객 불만'(버전 4.0, 시행일 2025-02-19) 6.5.7항은 기한이 지나기 전에 연장을 문서화하고 승인하도록 명시적으로 요구한다. 시정 및 예방조치: 2024-05부터 2026-05 사이에 개시된 시정 및 예방조치 기록 169건을 검토한 결과, 기한 안에 완료되거나 연장된 것은 36건(21.30%)뿐이었다. 나머지 133건(78.70%)은 기한 안에 연장 요청 없이 정해진 기한을 넘겼다. 회사의 SOP-002512192 '조치 추적 시스템 — 시정조치와 예방조치'(버전 13.0, 시행일 2025-06-09) 6.1.6항은 시정 및 예방조치가 기한 안에 종결되지 않을 경우 기한 연장을 요청하도록 요구한다. 회사는 단일하고 더 충실한 연장 요청을 제출하기 위해 기록이 의도적으로 기한을 넘기도록 허용되는 경우가 있다고 밝혔다. 이 관행은 회사가 정한 서면 절차와 일치하지 않으며 인용된 어느 SOP에서도 인정된 예외에 해당하지 않는다.

key_violations.observation: 2024년 이후 약 [가림]개 배치가 니트로사민 불순물(NDMA, NDEA, NMPA, NDIPA, NIPEA, NDBA, NMBA)의 안전 수준에 대한 보증 없이 미국 시장에 출하 승인됐다(관찰 1).
기준일탈(OOS) 조사 5건(번호 3700033, 3515421, 3789692, 3807659, 3843418)에서 미확인 피크(면적 0.2~3.0%)를 시료 조제 과정의 인위적 피크로 간주했고, SOP가 요구한 재조제·재분석을 수행하지 않았다. 분해 생성물 결과가 공식 안정성 기록에 불검출·정량한계 미만 등으로 보고됐다(관찰 2).
key_violations.risk: 해당 5건의 제품은 미국 시장에 출하됐다(관찰 2).

key_violations.observation: 2025-11부터 2026-04까지 제조·포장 구역에서 살아 있는 곤충(개미, 흰개미)이 나왔다는 방제 사건이 여럿 기록됐다. 2026-03-13 검사 중인 로트에서 개미가 확인되어 3.2 kg이 폐기됐고, 2026-03-17 흰개미 발견으로 공정 중인 로트 포장분이 폐기되고 제조·포장 작업이 중단됐다(관찰 3).
2024-04~2026-03 개시된 조사 기록 240건 중 연장이 필요한 219건에서 기한 안에 연장을 요청한 것은 37%였다. 불만 조사 104건 중 33%, 시정 및 예방조치 기록 169건 중 21.30%만 기한 안에 완료 또는 연장됐다(관찰 4).

deep_analysis.inspectional_significance: 니트로사민 불순물 관리 미흡은 지난 실사에서도 지적된 반복 결함이라고 원문이 적었다(관찰 1). 회사는 단일하고 더 충실한 연장 요청을 내기 위해 기한을 일부러 넘기는 경우가 있다고 설명했다(관찰 4).

required_remediation.deadline: 회신은 의무가 아니다. 15영업일 안에 받은 회신은 FDA가 후속 조치를 정할 때 검토한다.

en.title_issue: OOS results left out of records; product shipped
en.summary: FDA issued a Form 483 with 4 observations to Viatris Pharmaceuticals LLC, a finished dosage manufacturer, citing degradation product OOS results in stability samples that were not reported in official records while the products were shipped.
en.implication: OOS results of 0.7%, 0.2%, 0.3%, 3.0% and 0.3% were recorded as None Detected, <LOQ, 0.1, 0.10 and None Detected in official stability records, and the products were shipped to the U.S. (Observation 2). The quality control unit did not re-prepare and reanalyze samples the number of times the SOP requires (Observation 2). On 2026-03-13 product on an inspection table was exposed to an ant and 3.2 kg was discarded (Observation 3). From 2026-03-31 to 04-17, nine more pest events with live termites were identified (Observation 3). Only 36 of 169 CAPA records (21.30%) were completed or extended on time (Observation 4). The firm indicated records are sometimes intentionally allowed to exceed due dates to submit a single extension request (Observation 4).
key_facts: Observation 1: since 2024, batches released to the U.S. market without assurance of safe nitrosamine impurity levels, a repeat deficiency
Observation 2: stability OOS investigations inadequate; unidentified peaks deemed artifacts and other values reported in official records
Observation 3: live ants and termites found in manufacturing and packaging areas
Observation 4: investigations, complaints and CAPAs exceeded due dates without timely extension requests
checks: When deeming an unidentified stability peak an artifact, do you perform the reanalysis your SOP requires? (Observation 2)
Do you report OOS results as obtained in official stability records? (Observation 2)
Have you assessed nitrosamine impurity risk for each product before release? (Observation 1)
en.hook_line: Out-of-specification degradant result of 3.0% reported as 0.10 in the stability record

cards.summary: FDA가 SK Biotek Co., Ltd (Sejong Plant)에 Form 483(관찰사항 2건)을 발행했다. 미생물 한도시험 축소 운영의 근거와 공정 중 보관시간 기록을 지적했다.

facts.label: 제조소/업체
facts.value: SK Biotek Co., Ltd (Sejong Plant) · FEI 3014286622

key_facts: 관찰 1: 원료의약품(API) 미생물 한도시험을 건너뛰거나 줄이는 규격에 위험평가·과거 데이터 분석·밸리데이션 근거가 없음
관찰 2: 보관시간 연구는 있으나 제조기록서 등 생산 문서에 공정 단계 사이 보관시간을 기록·확인하지 않음
cards.implication: 2025년 4월 이후 그 원료의약품 배치가 미국 시장 출하 승인을 받았다(관찰 1). 2024년 11월 이후 미국 시장 출하 승인을 받은 배치도 보관시간 기록 없이 제조됐다(관찰 2).
checks: 미생물 한도시험 축소 운영에 위험평가와 과거 데이터 근거가 있는가? (관찰 1)
공정 단계 사이 보관시간을 제조기록서에 기록하고 확인하는가? (관찰 2)

observations.deficiency: Your firm's established specifications for the microbial enumeration testing of APlm@ @) (4) permit intermittent (skip-lot) or reduced testing frequency.
observations.detail: However, the firm has not provided adequate scientific justification to support this reduced testing program at your production facility. Specifically, The established specifications for the microbial enumeration testing ofAPI [redacted] state that ifm [redacted] batches all meet the acceptance criteria, the applicable test shall be conducted (4 ow and that the test must be conducted [redacted] However, no documented risk assessment, historical data analysis, or validation study was provided during the inspection to support the conclusion that reduced testing provides equivalent assurance of microbiological quality for the API batches produced at your facility. Since April 2025, approximatel [redacted] batches of the API [redacted] have been approved for release to the U.S. market.
observations.deficiency_ko: 회사가 정한 원료의약품의 미생물 계수 시험 규격은 간헐(skip-lot) 또는 감소된 시험 빈도를 허용한다.
observations.detail_ko: 그러나 회사는 이 생산 시설에서의 감소 시험 프로그램을 뒷받침하는 적절한 과학적 근거를 제시하지 않았다. 구체적으로, 원료의약품 [가림]의 미생물 계수 시험에 대해 정한 규격은 [가림]개 배치가 모두 판정 기준을 충족하면 해당 시험을 [가림]에 수행하고 시험은 [가림] 수행해야 한다고 정한다. 그러나 감소 시험이 이 시설에서 생산된 원료의약품 배치의 미생물 품질에 대해 동등한 보증을 제공한다는 결론을 뒷받침하는 문서화된 위험 평가, 과거 데이터 분석, 밸리데이션 연구가 실사 중 제공되지 않았다. 2025-04 이후 원료의약품 [가림] 약 [가림]개 배치가 미국 시장 출하 승인됐다.

observations.deficiency: Your firm has established hold time studies to support the maximum allowable storage duration or hold times for raw materials, intermediates, and finished APIs held between manufacturing steps and stages.
observations.detail: However, the hold times are not documented and verified in the batch record or other production documents. Specifically, Your firm's manufacturing process for the production of the APIs oe 0) includes [redacted] major process stages for each finished API. It is unclear in the API production batch records whether hold steps are required and documented during the process stages. No written procedures or risk assessments were provided during the inspection to justify the lack of hold time documentation and verification to ensure that materials, intermediates, and finished APIs are held at various stages during production and prior to final API packaging without adversely affecting quality attributes, such as purity, microbial limits, and moisture content. Since November 2024, approximatel [redacted] batches of the oe oe have been approved for release to the U.S. market.
observations.deficiency_ko: 회사는 제조 단계 사이에 보관되는 원료, 중간체, 완제 원료의약품의 최대 허용 보관 기간 또는 보관시간을 뒷받침하는 보관시간 연구를 수립했다.
observations.detail_ko: 그러나 보관시간이 제조기록서나 다른 생산 문서에 문서화·확인되지 않는다. 구체적으로, 회사의 원료의약품 제조 공정은 완제 원료의약품마다 [가림]개의 주요 공정 단계를 포함한다. 원료의약품 생산 제조기록서에서는 공정 단계 중 보관 단계가 요구되는지, 문서화되는지가 분명하지 않다. 순도, 미생물 한도, 수분 함량 같은 품질 특성에 불리한 영향 없이 생산 중 여러 단계와 최종 원료의약품 포장 전에 원료, 중간체, 완제 원료의약품이 보관됨을 보증하기 위해 보관시간 문서화·확인의 부재를 정당화하는 서면 절차나 위험 평가가 실사 중 제공되지 않았다. 2024-11 이후 [가림] 약 [가림]개 배치가 미국 시장 출하 승인됐다.

key_violations.observation: 원료의약품 [가림]의 미생물 계수 시험 규격이 간헐(skip-lot) 또는 감소된 시험 빈도를 허용하나, 이 감소 시험 프로그램을 뒷받침하는 적절한 과학적 근거를 제시하지 못했다. 위험 평가, 과거 데이터 분석, 밸리데이션 연구가 실사 중 제공되지 않았다(관찰 1).
key_violations.risk: 2025-04 이후 이 원료의약품 [가림]개 배치가 미국 시장 출하 승인됐다(관찰 1).

en.title_issue: Reduced microbial testing not justified
en.summary: FDA issued a Form 483 with two observations to SK Biotek Co., Ltd (Sejong Plant), covering the justification for reduced microbial testing and documentation of hold times.
en.implication: Since April 2025, batches of the API have been approved for release to the U.S. market (Observation 1). Since November 2024, batches have also been approved for release to the U.S. market without hold time documentation (Observation 2).
key_facts: Observation 1: API specifications permit skip-lot or reduced microbial enumeration testing with no risk assessment, historical data analysis or validation study
Observation 2: hold time studies exist, but hold times between manufacturing steps are not documented or verified in batch records
checks: Is reduced microbial testing backed by a risk assessment and historical data? (Observation 1)
Are hold times between process stages recorded and verified in batch records? (Observation 2)
en.hook_line: Skip-lot microbial enumeration testing used without a documented scientific justification

items.orig: Your firm's established specifications for the microbial enumeration testing of APlm@ @) (4) permit intermittent (skip-lot) or reduced testing frequency.
items.text: 회사가 정한 원료의약품의 미생물 계수 시험 규격은 간헐(skip-lot) 또는 감소된 시험 빈도를 허용한다.

items.orig: Your firm has established hold time studies to support the maximum allowable storage duration or hold times for raw materials, intermediates, and finished APIs held between manufacturing steps and stages.
items.text: 회사는 제조 단계 사이에 보관되는 원료, 중간체, 완제 원료의약품의 최대 허용 보관 기간 또는 보관시간을 뒷받침하는 보관시간 연구를 수립했다.

observations.detail_ko: 구체적으로, 회사는 현장에서 제조한 [가림]과 [가림]의 분석에 쓰는 분석기를 약 [가림]대 운영한다. 출하용 [가림]과 [가림]의 트레일러·트럭 충전 중 이 분석기가 생성한 전자 원천 데이터가 보관되지 않는다. 예를 들어: 회사는 [가림] NF, 로트 [가림]의 출하용 벌크 충전 중 트레일러·트럭 내용물을 시험한 분석기 [가림]의 전자 원천 데이터를 보관하지 못했다. 회사는 [가림] USP, 로트 [가림]의 출하용 벌크 충전 중 트레일러 내용물을 시험한 분석기 [가림]의 전자 원천 데이터를 보관하지 못했다.

observations.detail: Specifically, second-person review of Certificates of Analysis (CoAs) used to release [redacted] and [redacted] is deficient, in that CoAs are not reviewed against source data prior to product release to ensure accuracy of reported data, as specified in your procedure #s 40.25 and 40.24, that governs the loading ofUSP [redacted] bulk trailer and NF [redacted] bulk trailer respectively.

observations.detail_ko: 구체적으로, [가림]과 [가림]을 출하하는 데 쓰는 시험성적서(COA)의 제2자 검토가 미흡하다. 시험성적서가 각각 USP [가림] 벌크 트레일러와 NF [가림] 벌크 트레일러의 적재를 규율하는 회사의 절차 40.25와 40.24가 정한 대로 제품 출하 전에 원천 데이터와 대조해 보고된 데이터의 정확성을 확인하는 검토를 받지 않는다.

key_violations.observation: 의료용 가스 [가림]과 [가림] 출하 때 트레일러·트럭 내용물을 시험하는 분석기의 전자 원천 데이터를 보관하지 않는다. 분석기를 약 [가림]대 운영하며, 로트 [가림](NF)과 로트 [가림](USP)의 출하 충전 때 데이터가 보관되지 않았다(관찰 1).
절차 40.25와 40.24가 정한 대로 시험성적서(COA)를 원천 데이터와 대조해 제품 출하 전에 검토하지 않아 제2자 검토가 미흡하다(관찰 2).

cards.summary: FDA가 Sagecor Health, LLC에 Form 483(관찰사항 2건)을 발행했다. 재가공 배치의 조사 미실시와 재가공 기록 미작성을 지적했다.
key_facts: 관찰 1: 재가공 절차서가 재가공 배치에 일탈이 필요 없다고 정해, 포일 파우치 밀봉 불량 등으로 재가공한 배치의 원인을 조사하지 않음
관찰 2: 재가공마다 제조기록서를 만들지 않았고, 기존 재가공 기록과 포장·표시 자재 수불 기록이 불완전하거나 맞지 않음
cards.implication: 한 배치는 품질 담당자가 재가공 사유를 밀봉 불량으로, 작업자는 표시 문제로 적었으나 그 차이를 조사하거나 맞추지 않았다(관찰 1). 회사는 이런 사례를 추적·경향 분석하지 않았다(관찰 1). 직원들은 한 배치의 자재 수불 기록 계산 차이를 실사 중 설명하지 못했다(관찰 2).
checks: 재가공한 배치도 원인 조사와 시정 및 예방조치(CAPA)를 거치는가? (관찰 1)
재가공마다 별도 제조기록서와 자재 수불 기록을 만드는가? (관찰 2)

observations.deficiency: There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy and the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
observations.detail: Specifically, your firm does not perform investigations for reprocessed batches. Your firms reprocessing procedure, SOP WI-082, Reprocessing Packaged Drugs, effective date 06/20/2024, Rev. B, specifically calls out that deviations are not required for reprocessed batches, indicating that investigations would not be performed. When actions are taken, they are limited to immediate corrective measures, such as operator coaching, without a documented evaluation of the underlying cause. For example, A. Batch [redacted] of [redacted] Tablets was reprocessed due to improperly sealed foil pouches; however, no investigation was conducted to determine whether the failure resulted from operator error, equipment malfunction, inadequate process controls, or another assignable cause. Additionally, quality personnel documented the reason for reprocessing as a sealing failure, while the operator documented the reason as a labeling issue on the in-process deviation form. The discrepancy was neither investigated nor reconciled, and the batch record does not establish the actual reason for reprocessing. B. Batch [redacted] of [redacted] Tablets was reprocessed due to improperly sealed foil pouches. No investigation was conducted to determine whether the failure resulted from operator error, equipment malfunction, inadequate process controls, or another assignable cause. Your firm lacks assurance that appropriate corrective and preventive actions have been implemented to prevent recurrence of similar failures. C. Batch [redacted] of product [redacted] was reprocessed due to labeling defects and leaking ()(); however, the quantity of units affected by each defect was not recorded. There was no investigation performed as to the cause of the leaking [redacted] and the batch record does not adequately identify the extent of each defect or reconcile the affected units. Furthermore, your firm does not track and trend these events to identify recurring failure modes, assess whether systemic issues are contributing to repeated occurrences, or implement corrective actions. Your firm has reprocessed approximately [redacted] batches since June of 2024 without adequate tracking, trending, or investigations.
observations.deficiency_ko: 원인이 설명되지 않은 불일치와 배치 또는 그 구성 성분의 규격 미충족을, 해당 배치가 이미 유통되었는지와 관계없이 철저히 검토하지 못했다.
observations.detail_ko: 구체적으로, 회사는 재처리 배치에 대한 조사를 수행하지 않는다. 회사의 재처리 절차 SOP WI-082 "포장 의약품 재처리"(시행일 2024-06-20, Rev. B)는 재처리 배치에 일탈이 필요하지 않다고 명시하고 있어 조사가 수행되지 않을 것임을 보여준다. 조치가 이루어지는 경우에도 작업자 지도 같은 즉각 시정 조치에 한정되며 근본 원인에 대한 문서화된 평가는 없다. 예를 들어, A. [가림] 정제의 배치 [가림]은 호일 파우치 밀봉 불량으로 재처리되었으나, 작업자 실수, 설비 고장, 공정 관리 미흡 또는 기타 특정 가능한 원인 중 무엇 때문인지 판단하는 조사가 수행되지 않았다. 또한 품질 담당자는 재처리 사유를 밀봉 불량으로 기록한 반면 작업자는 공정 중 일탈 양식에 표시 문제로 기록했다. 이 불일치는 조사되거나 정리되지 않았고, 제조기록서에는 실제 재처리 사유가 확인되지 않는다. B. [가림] 정제의 배치 [가림]은 호일 파우치 밀봉 불량으로 재처리되었다. 작업자 실수, 설비 고장, 공정 관리 미흡 또는 기타 특정 가능한 원인 중 무엇 때문인지 판단하는 조사가 수행되지 않았다. 회사에는 유사한 불량의 재발을 막기 위한 적절한 시정 및 예방조치(CAPA)가 시행되었다는 보증이 없다. C. 제품 [가림]의 배치 [가림]은 표시 불량과 [가림] 누출로 재처리되었으나, 각 불량에 영향을 받은 단위 수량이 기록되지 않았다. [가림] 누출의 원인에 대한 조사가 수행되지 않았고, 제조기록서에는 각 불량의 범위가 적절히 확인되거나 영향받은 단위가 정산되지 않았다. 또한 회사는 반복되는 고장 양상을 파악하고, 시스템 문제가 반복 발생에 기여하는지 평가하고, 시정 조치를 시행하기 위해 이러한 사건을 추적하고 경향을 분석하지 않는다. 회사는 2024-06 이후 약 [가림]개 배치를 적절한 추적, 경향 분석, 조사 없이 재처리했다.

observations.deficiency: Batch production and control records are not prepared for each batch of drug product produced and do not include complete information relating to the production and control of each batch.
observations.detail: Specifically, batch production and control records are not generated for each reprocessing event, and existing reprocessing records are incomplete and inaccurate. Examples include, but are not limited to: A. During reprocessing of Batch [redacted] _—_—of [redacted], labels and overwraps were discarded; however, no secondary accountability form was generated as required by procedure, WI-082, Reprocessing Packaged Drugs, effective date 06/20/2024, Rev. B. Instead, the discarded components were documented on the original accountability form, leaving component disposition and reconciliation inadequately documented. B. Packaging and labeling component accountability records for batch [redacted] _—of [redacted] contained discrepancies and calculations that firm personnel were unable to explain during the inspection. As a result, the accuracy and completeness of component accountability could not be verified.
observations.deficiency_ko: 의약품의 각 배치에 대한 배치 생산 및 관리 기록이 작성되지 않았고, 각 배치의 생산과 관리에 관한 완전한 정보를 포함하지 않는다.
observations.detail_ko: 구체적으로, 재처리 건마다 배치 생산 및 관리 기록이 작성되지 않으며, 기존 재처리 기록도 불완전하고 부정확하다. 예는 다음을 포함하나 이에 한정되지 않는다: A. [가림]의 배치 [가림] 재처리 중 라벨과 겉포장이 폐기되었으나, 절차 WI-082 "포장 의약품 재처리"(시행일 2024-06-20, Rev. B)가 요구하는 2차 수불 양식이 작성되지 않았다. 대신 폐기된 구성품이 원래 수불 양식에 기록되어 구성품 처리와 정산이 불충분하게 문서화되었다. B. [가림]의 배치 [가림]의 포장 및 표시 구성품 수불 기록에는 실사 중 회사 직원이 설명하지 못한 불일치와 계산이 있었다. 그 결과 구성품 수불의 정확성과 완전성을 확인할 수 없었다.

key_violations.observation: 재처리 배치에 대한 조사를 하지 않는다. 재처리 절차서 SOP WI-082(Reprocessing Packaged Drugs, 시행 2024-06-20, Rev. B)가 재처리 배치에 일탈 처리가 필요 없다고 정하고, 조치는 작업자 지도 같은 즉각 시정에 그쳐 근본 원인 평가를 문서화하지 않는다(관찰 1).
key_violations.risk: 2024-06 이후 재처리한 배치가 추적·경향 분석·조사 없이 반복됐다(관찰 1).

key_violations.observation: 호일 파우치 밀봉 불량으로 재처리한 정제 배치 2건에 작업자 실수·설비 고장·공정 관리 미흡 등 원인을 가리는 조사가 없다. 한 배치는 품질 담당자가 밀봉 불량으로, 작업자는 표시 문제로 재처리 사유를 서로 다르게 적었으나 조사·정리되지 않았다(관찰 1).
재처리 건마다 배치 생산 및 관리 기록이 작성되지 않았고 기존 재처리 기록도 불완전하고 부정확하다. 폐기한 라벨·포장재는 절차서가 요구한 별도 수불 양식 없이 원래 양식에 기록돼 구성품 처리·정산이 불충분하다(관찰 2).
포장·표시 구성품 수불 기록의 불일치와 계산을 회사 직원이 설명하지 못해 정확성과 완전성을 확인할 수 없었다(관찰 2).

required_remediation.deadline: 회신은 의무가 아니다. 15영업일 안에 받은 회신은 FDA가 후속 조치를 정할 때 검토한다.

cards.hook_line: 절차서가 재가공 배치에는 일탈이 필요 없다고 정해 조사하지 않음

en.title_issue: Reprocessed batches not investigated
en.summary: FDA issued a Form 483 with two observations to Sagecor Health, LLC, citing reprocessed batches that are not investigated and missing reprocessing batch records.
en.implication: For one batch, quality personnel recorded the reprocessing reason as a sealing failure while the operator recorded a labeling issue, and the discrepancy was not investigated or reconciled (Observation 1). The firm does not track and trend these events (Observation 1). Personnel could not explain accountability discrepancies for one batch during the inspection (Observation 2).
key_facts: Observation 1: the reprocessing SOP states deviations are not required, so batches reprocessed for improperly sealed foil pouches and other defects were not investigated
Observation 2: batch records are not generated for each reprocessing event, and reprocessing and component accountability records are incomplete or inaccurate
checks: Do reprocessed batches go through root-cause investigation and CAPA? (Observation 1)
Is a separate batch record and accountability form generated for each reprocessing event? (Observation 2)
en.hook_line: Procedure says reprocessed batches need no deviation, so none are investigated

items.orig: There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy and the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
items.text: 원인이 설명되지 않은 불일치와 배치 또는 그 구성 성분의 규격 미충족을, 해당 배치가 이미 유통되었는지와 관계없이 철저히 검토하지 못했다.

items.orig: Batch production and control records are not prepared for each batch of drug product produced and do not include complete information relating to the production and control of each batch.
items.text: 의약품의 각 배치에 대한 배치 생산 및 관리 기록이 작성되지 않았고, 각 배치의 생산과 관리에 관한 완전한 정보를 포함하지 않는다.

cards.summary: 식약처(서울지방식품의약품안전청)가 삼성서울병원 방사성의약품제조소를 정기 실사하고 지적(보완)사항이 있다고 판정했다.

quotes.original: 평가 결과: 지적(보완)사항(Deficiencies) 있음 1) GMP 감시 분야(6개): 품질경영, 시설장비, 제조, 시험실, 원자재, 포장표시 2) PIC/S 정의에 따라 중대, 중요, 기타로 작성 3) 지적사항 중 ‘중대･중요’ 건은 행정처분 부과, ‘기타’ 건은 시정·보완토록 함 행정처분 부과가 확정되면 ‘의약품안전나라 행정처분정보’를 통해 공개됨 ‘중대･중요’ 지적사항은 보완 완료 후, ‘기타’ 지적사항은 이행계획 확인 후 타당성이 인…

key_facts: 지적 1: 품질경영(기타) — 시험수행자와 시험 결과를 검토·승인하는 자를 분리할 것([별표1] 제3.1)
평가 결과: 지적(보완)사항 있음
후속: 보완완료
cards.implication: 실사 대상은 무균 방사성의약품 주사제 완제의약품이었다.
checks: 시험수행자와 시험 결과 검토·승인자가 서로 다른 사람으로 지정돼 있는가? (지적 1)
시험 기록의 수행자 서명과 승인자 서명이 같은 사람인 경우가 없는가? (지적 1)
cards.hook_line: 품질경영 분야 기타 지적, 시험수행자와 승인자 분리 요구

en.title_issue: Radiopharmaceutical inspection finding resolved
en.summary: MFDS (Seoul Regional Office) conducted a routine inspection of a hospital radiopharmaceutical manufacturing site and found deficiencies.
en.implication: The inspection covered sterile radiopharmaceutical injection finished products.
key_facts: Finding 1: quality management (other) — separate the person performing tests from the person reviewing and approving results (Annex 1, 3.1)
Outcome: deficiencies found
Follow-up: corrected
checks: Are the tester and the reviewer and approver of test results assigned to different people? (Finding 1)
Are there any test records where the tester and approver signatures are the same person? (Finding 1)
en.hook_line: Other-level quality management finding requiring separation of tester and approver

facts.label: 처분
facts.value:
○ 해당 품목* 신고취소(2026. 12. 10.)
 * 해당 품목: 후레쉬드림아이액(폴리헥사메틸렌비구아니드염산염액20%)

quotes.original:
○ 제조업무정지 기간에 제조업무를 수행한 사실이 있음
  - 해당 품목 제조업무정지 기간(2026. 6. 16. ~ 2026. 6. 30.)에 의약외품 “후레쉬드림아이액(폴리헥사메틸렌비구아니드염산염액20%)”의 제조업무를 수행한 사실이 있음

key_facts: 위반: 제조업무정지 기간(2026-06-16~2026-06-30)에 의약외품 후레쉬드림아이액 제조업무를 수행
처분: 해당 품목 신고취소(2026-12-10)
근거: 약사법 제76조제1항제3호 및 제3항
checks: 행정처분 정지 기간이 생산 계획에 등록돼 제조지시가 막히는가?
정지 기간 중 제조 기록이 없는지 처분 종료 뒤 확인하는가?

key_violations.original: 해당 품목 제조업무정지 기간(2026. 6. 16. ~ 2026. 6. 30.)에 의약외품 “후레쉬드림아이액(폴리헥사메틸렌비구아니드염산염액20%)”의 제조업무를 수행한 사실이 있음
key_violations.description: 해당 품목의 제조업무정지 기간인 2026-06-16부터 2026-06-30까지 의약외품 '후레쉬드림아이액(폴리헥사메틸렌비구아니드염산염액20%)'의 제조업무를 수행했다(위반 1).

deep_analysis.disposition_basis: 처분은 해당 품목 후레쉬드림아이액(폴리헥사메틸렌비구아니드염산염액20%) 신고취소다. 처분명에는 2026-12-10이, 최종처분일자에는 2026-11-26이 적혀 있다. 사유는 제조업무정지 기간 중 제조업무를 수행한 것이다.

required_remediation.deadline: 처분명에 적힌 일자: 2026-12-10

deep_analysis.administrative_risks: 처분문은 적용법령으로 ｢약사법｣ 제76조제1항제3호 및 제3항과, ｢의약품 등의 안전에 관한 규칙｣ 제95조 관련 [별표8] 행정처분의 기준 Ⅰ.일반기준 제10호를 적었다.

cards.hook_line: 제조업무정지 기간에 의약외품을 제조해 품목 신고취소

en.title_issue: Made during suspension, notification revoked
en.summary: MFDS revoked a manufacturer's product notification after it carried out manufacturing of a quasi-drug during a manufacturing suspension period.
key_facts: Violation: manufacturing of a quasi-drug eye product carried out during the suspension period (2026-06-16 to 2026-06-30)
Sanction: revocation of the product notification (2026-12-10)
Basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Article 76(1)3 and 76(3)
checks: Are sanction suspension periods entered in production planning so that manufacturing orders are blocked?
Do you confirm after a suspension that no manufacturing took place during it?
en.hook_line: Quasi-drug manufactured during a manufacturing suspension, leading to revocation

cards.title_issue: 기록 거짓 작성, GMP 적합판정 취소
cards.summary: 식약처가 에스피씨(주)에 세팔로스포린제제 의약품 제조 및 품질관리기준 적합판정 취소를 처분했다. 허가와 다르게 제조하고 제조지시 및 기록서와 무균시험 기록을 반복해 거짓 작성했다.

facts.label: 처분
facts.value:
○ ‘의약품 제조 및 품질관리기준 적합판정’ 취소를 명함(2026. 12. 8.자)
    - 대상: 세팔로스포린제제[합성(무균), 합성(비무균)]

quotes.original:
○ ‘세포테탄(제20221117-210-J-1405호)’을 제조하면서 포장 후 잔량, 제조기록서가 없는(제조번호나 유효기간 미상) 원료 등을 혼합한 후 1개 배치로 제조하는 등 허가받은 사항과 다르게 제조하였으나, 마치 허가 사항과 동일하게 제조한 것처럼 ‘제조지시 및 기록서’를 반복적으로 거짓 작성한 사실이 있음
○ ‘세포티암염산염·건조탄산나트륨(제20151126-117-G-132-08호)’ 등 6품목을 제조하면서 해당 품목에 대한 무균시험이…

key_facts: 위반: 세포테탄을 포장 후 잔량과 제조기록서가 없는 원료 등을 섞어 1개 배치로 제조하고 '제조지시 및 기록서'를 허가 사항과 같은 것처럼 반복 거짓 작성
경위: 세포티암염산염·건조탄산나트륨 등 6품목의 무균시험이 진행 중인데 시험 시작일·종료일을 거짓 작성하고 시험성적서를 적합 처리해 출하
처분: 세팔로스포린제제[합성(무균), 합성(비무균)] GMP 적합판정 취소(2026-12-08)
근거: 약사법 제38조의3제1항 및 제3항제2호
checks: 무균시험이 끝나기 전에 시험성적서가 발행되지 않도록 막는 절차가 있는가?
제조에 투입한 모든 원료가 제조번호와 유효기간으로 추적되는가?

key_violations.description: 처분문은 세포테탄 제조에서 포장 후 잔량과 제조기록서가 없는 원료를 혼합해 1개 배치로 제조하는 등 허가받은 사항과 다르게 제조하고도 허가 사항대로 제조한 것처럼 제조지시 및 기록서를 반복해서 거짓으로 작성했다고 적었다(위반 1).
처분문은 세포티암염산염·건조탄산나트륨 등 6품목 제조 중 무균시험이 진행 중이었는데도 시험 시작일과 종료일을 거짓으로 적어 시험이 끝난 것처럼 시험일지를 작성했고, 결과가 확인되지 않은 채 시험성적서를 적합으로 처리해 출하를 진행했다고 적었다(위반 2).
key_violations.risk: 시험 결과가 확인되지 않은 채 시험성적서를 적합으로 처리해 출하가 진행됐다(위반 2).

deep_analysis.disposition_basis: 처분은 2026-12-08자 '의약품 제조 및 품질관리기준 적합판정' 취소 명령이며 대상은 세팔로스포린제제(합성(무균), 합성(비무균))이다.

required_remediation.deadline: 적합판정 취소 처분일 2026-12-08
items: 세팔로스포린제제[합성(무균), 합성(비무균)]에 대한 의약품 제조 및 품질관리기준 적합판정을 취소한다(2026-12-08자).

cards.hook_line: 무균시험 결과 확인 전 시험성적서를 적합 처리해 출하

en.title_issue: Falsified records, GMP certificate revoked
en.summary: MFDS revoked a manufacturer's GMP compliance certification for cephalosporin preparations after it manufactured products differently from the approval and repeatedly falsified manufacturing and sterility test records.
key_facts: Violation: cefotetan made in one batch by mixing post-packaging leftovers and materials without manufacturing records, with manufacturing instruction and records repeatedly falsified to match the approval

Timeline: for 6 products including cefotiam hydrochloride and sodium carbonate, sterility test dates were falsified while testing was in progress, and test certificates were marked as passing and products shipped
Sanction: revocation of GMP compliance certification for cephalosporin preparations (sterile and non-sterile synthesis), 2026-12-08
Basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Article 38-3
checks: Is there a procedure that prevents issuing test certificates before sterility testing is complete?
Is every material used in manufacturing traceable by batch number and expiry date?
en.hook_line: Test certificates marked passing and products shipped before sterility results were known

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC- 41565600 Marketing Authorisation Holder Mercury Pharmaceuticals Limited Medicine Details Bexarotene 75 mg soft capsules PLGB: 12762/0686 Active Ingredient: bexarotene SNOMED code: 41459011000001108 GTIN: 05021691004929 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed 5GJ0551 30/09/2027 100 Capsules 10/04/2026 Background Mercury Pharmaceuticals Limited is recalling Bexarotene 75 mg Soft Capsules, batch 5GJ0551, as a precautionary measure following the identification of several capsules with black/blue spots during additional Acceptable Quality Limit (AQL) testing at the pre-wholesaler’s site. The testing was initiated following receipt of a complaint from a pharmacy in the UK. Advice for Healthcare Professionals Stop supplying the above batch immediately. Quarantine all remaining packs and return it to your supplier using your supplier’s approved process. Should a patient present a pack with black or blue spots on the capsules, pharmacy teams should contact the prescriber and exercise their professional judgement to supply replacement medication. Advice for Healthcare Professionals to Provide to Patients This is a Pharmacy and Wholesaler level recall; therefore, no further action is required by patients. The recall is out of an abundance of caution and no patient harm reports have been received. Should you be in possession of this batch of medicine and have any questions, please contact your dispensing pharmacy in the first instance. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about their medication should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme . Additional information For all medical information enquiries and information on this product, please email medicalinformation@advanzpharma.com or telephone +44 (0) 208 588 9131. Recipients of this Medicines Recall should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 3 Medicines Recall: Mercury Pharmaceuticals Limited, Bexarotene 75 mg soft capsules, EL(26)A/51

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC-41456133 Marketing Authorisation Holder Takeda UK Limited Medicine Details PROSTAP PD DCS 1.88 mg powder and solvent for prolonged-release suspension for injection in pre-filled syringe PL: 16189/0038 Active ingredient: leuprorelin acetate SNOMED code: 42797911000001100 GTIN: 07038319160767 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed 523373 09/2027 1 pre-filled syringe October 2025 518961 03/2026 1 pre-filled syringe December 2024 Background Takeda UK Limited has identified an error in the administration instructions and labelling for PROSTAP PD DCS 1.88 mg. The product should only be administered by subcutaneous injection. Section 4.2 of the Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) states that the product should be administered as a once monthly single subcutaneous injection, and the outer carton also specifies subcutaneous administration. However, Step 5 of the administration instructions in the SmPC and Healthcare Professionals’ User Leaflet incorrectly states that the product can be administered either subcutaneously or intramuscularly. The immediate syringe label also incorrectly states “For SC or IM use after reconstitution’’. This is a labelling defect. No manufacturing, formulation, identity, strength or purity defect has been identified. No confirmed cases of administration by the incorrect route or associated adverse clinical outcomes have been identified for the UK presentation. Available evidence does not indicate serious systemic harm or clinically meaningful loss of efficacy. Takeda UK Limited have classified the expected severity of harm as minor, mainly involving temporary and manageable injection-site reactions. However, direct evidence comparing the pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic effects of subcutaneous and intramuscular administration is not available. Due to the requirement for these products to support the UK market, the MHRA in discussion with the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) consider that batches which are currently packed and available for distribution, will continue to be distributed until replacement stock becomes available, which is currently anticipated in March/April 2027. Two batches are included within the scope of this notification. Batch 518961 is now expired; however, as it was affected by the same labelling defect, it should remain within the scope of this notification and any associated follow-up review of patients. Takeda UK Limited is progressing corrective regulatory action to ensure that the product information and labelling consistently state the approved subcutaneous route. Advice for Healthcare Professionals PROSTAP PD DCS 1.88 mg should only be given as an injection under the skin (subcutaneous injection). Do not administer the product by intramuscular injection. The affected administration instructions and immediate syringe label incorrectly state that the product may be administered by either the subcutaneous or intramuscular route. Healthcare professionals should continue to prescribe, dispense and administer the product where clinically appropriate, ensuring that it is administered by the subcutaneous route in accordance with the approved product information. The treating paediatric endocrinology team should review the patient’s administration records to confirm the route of administration. Where the records indicate that the product may have been administered intramuscularly, appropriate clinical follow-up should be considered, including confirmation of continued suppression of pubertal progression. Advice for Patients Patients should continue treatment as advised by their healthcare professional. The quality of the product is not affected. This product should be prepared, reconstituted and administered only by healthcare professionals who are familiar with these procedures. The medicine should be given once every month as a single injection under the skin (subcutaneously) and not administered via any other routes. Treatment should not be stopped or changed without advice from the patient’s specialist or another healthcare professional. Patients or carers with concerns should contact their treating healthcare professional. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about the medication, should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme . Additional information For medical information enquiries please email medinfoemea@takeda.com or telephone 03333 000 181. For stock control enquiries please email ukie.supplychain@takeda.com . Recipients of this Medicines Notification should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 4 Medicines Defect Notification: Takeda UK Limited, PROSTAP PD DCS 1.88 mg powder and solvent for prolonged-release suspension for injection in pre-filled syringe, EL(26)A/52

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC- 41342836 Marketing Authorisation Holder Quadrant Pharmaceuticals Limited (Parallel Import) Medicine Details Brintellix 5 mg Film-coated tablets (incorrectly packed as Brintellix 10 mg Film-coated tablets) PLPI: 20774/2321 Active Ingredient: vortioxetine GTIN (5 mg tablets): 05 060537 816784 GTIN (10 mg tablets): 05 060537 816791 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed 2856920/4245Z (MAX 4245Z) 08/2029 28 film-coated tablets 07/10/2026 Background Quadrant Pharmaceuticals Ltd is recalling one batch of Brintellix 5 mg film-coated tablets (mislabelled as 10 mg tablets) due to a labelling error with the product strength impacting an unknown number of units. A number of packs containing Brintellix 5 mg film-coated tablets have been supplied in sealed cartons labelled as Brintellix 10 mg film-coated tablets. Only the parallel imported packs are impacted by this defect. Advice for Healthcare Professionals Check any parallel imported packs of Brintellix 10 mg tablets with the batch number 2856920 and secondary batch number MAX 4245Z. If you are in receipt of these tablets, quarantine all remaining stock and return it to your supplier using your supplier’s approved process. Where possible, patients provided with a parallel imported Brintellix 10 mg pack from this batch should be contacted and told to confirm the strength stated on the tablet blisters matches that on the carton and their prescribed medication. Should a patient be in possession of a pack with the incorrect medicine, pharmacy teams should exercise their professional judgement to supply the correct medication. Should a patient prescribed Brintellix 10 mg inadvertently take Brintellix 5 mg, the clinical risk to the patient is possible reduced effectiveness. This can cause a persistence or worsening of depressive symptoms, recurrence of major depressive episodes and, in susceptible patients, potentially serious deterioration in mental health, including the possible emergence or worsening of suicidal ideation or suicidal behaviour. However, 5 mg is an approved minimum daily dose of this product. Advice for Healthcare Professionals to Provide to Patients Quadrant pharmaceuticals have received reports of a carton of Brintellix 10 mg film-coated tablets containing blister strips labelled and containing Brintellix 5 mg film-coated tablets. The 10 mg packs are being recalled as a precautionary measure. If you were prescribed Brintellix 10 mg film-coated tablets and received a Quadrant Pharmaceuticals pack with the batch number 2856920/4245Z and secondary batch number MAX 4245Z (see the image below), please contact your pharmacy as soon as possible. Return the pack to your pharmacy along with a copy of this notification. If you believe you have taken 10 mg tablets from this batch with a lower dose than you require and are currently experiencing persistence or worsening of depressive symptoms, please seek immediate medical advice. Please take your medication with you to your healthcare professional. If you are unsure or have any questions, please seek advice from your pharmacy or other healthcare professionals involved in your treatment. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about the medication should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme. Additional information For all medical information enquiries and information on this product, please email maxearnqa@maxearn.co.uk or telephone 01204 471 269. Recipients of this Medicines Recall should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 2 Medicines Recall: Quadrant Pharmaceuticals Limited (Parallel Import), Brintellix 5 mg film-coated tablets, EL(26)A/49 Image showing batch and MAX number location

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC- 41436161 Marketing Authorisation Holder Atnahs Pharma UK Limited Medicine details Toradol 30 mg/mL Solution for Injection PL: 43252/0009 Active Ingredient: ketorolac trometamol SNOMED code: 4061611000001109 GTIN: 5056227201800 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed F3075F01 05 2029 5 04.08.2026 F3081F02 10 2029 5 Not yet distributed F3074F04 05 2029 5 04.08.2026 F3074F03 05 2029 5 04.08.2026 F3072F02 03 2029 5 05.06.2026 F3070F04 10 2028 5 10.12.2025 F3067F02 06 2028 5 13.10.2025 F3065F03 04 2028 5 21.07.2025 F3062F05 01 2028 5 09.04.2025 Background Atnahs Pharma UK Ltd has informed the MHRA that safety information relating to gastrointestinal anastomotic leakage was omitted from the Patient Information Leaflets (PILs) supplied with certain batches of Toradol 30 mg/mL solution for injection. Specifically, the following text is missing from Section 2 of the PIL: “Tell your doctor if you recently had or you are going to have a surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract before receiving/taking/using Toradol, as Toradol can sometimes worsen wound healing in your gut after surgery.” Consequently, 91,134 packs from 8 affected batches were distributed with an outdated PIL. Currently all available stock contains the affected version of the PIL. To minimise the risk of supply disruption, one batch that has not yet been distributed is also included in this notification. All other information on the label, in the Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) and in the PIL is correct. Advice for Healthcare Professionals Healthcare professionals should consider the information in this notification when prescribing, dispensing to new patients or administering Toradol 30 mg/mL solution for injection. The PIL supplied with the affected batches omits information advising patients to inform their healthcare professional if they have recently had, or are going to have, surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract. Healthcare professionals should therefore consider this omission when assessing patients before treatment and, where appropriate, verify this information directly with the patient before Toradol is administered. The issue does not affect the quality of the physical product formulation or efficacy of the medicinal product. The risk associated with the omission error is considered low because the approved safety information remains available within the current SmPC and should be referred to when prescribing, dispensing, or administering the product. Additionally, the existing PIL also contains other relevant precautions concerning gastrointestinal complications and surgery. Healthcare professionals are advised to reassure patients, if contacted, that the affected batches of Toradol 30 mg/mL solution for injection remain suitable for use. Advice for Healthcare Professionals to Provide to Patients Patients should continue treatment as advised by their healthcare professional. The issue does not affect the quality or efficacy of the medicinal product. Patients should tell their healthcare professional if they have recently had, or are going to have, surgery of the stomach or intestinal tract, as Toradol can sometimes worsen wound healing in the gut after surgery. If you are unsure or have any questions, please seek advice from healthcare professionals involved in your treatment. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about their medication should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme. Additional information For all medical information enquiries and information on this product, please email info@pharmanovia.com or telephone +44 (0)1268 943700. Recipients of this Medicines Notification should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 4 Medicines Defect Notification: Atnahs Pharma UK Limited, Toradol 30 mg/mL Solution for Injection, EL(26)A/50
